findings.description: Creating a Stripe Checkout session always sets each line item quantity to 1, so customers are charged for one unit per SKU even when the cart has higher quantities.
reproSteps: Open http://127.0.0.1:5173/, add Organic Bananas (6 ct) and increase quantity to 2, add Avocados qty 1, add 2% Milk qty 2 using the + control.
Click Checkout and read Stripe’s order summary total and per-line quantities before paying.
findings.observedBehavior: Cart showed $21.55 but Stripe Checkout showed $13.77 with only one banana and one milk on the receipt-style list (sum of single-unit prices only).
findings.expectedBehavior: Stripe amount and line quantities must match the cart (e.g. two bananas must contribute $6.98 toward the session total, and the grand total must equal the in-app cart total exactly).
domHints: Circular +/- quantity controls beside each cart line

findings.description: After paying in Stripe, the shopper tab at 127.0.0.1 showed no checkout query string and no payment-confirmed notice even though the cart appeared empty, consistent with success_url defaulting to localhost while the session was started on 127.0.0.1.
reproSteps: Browse only at http://127.0.0.1:5173/ (do not open localhost:5173).
Complete a Stripe test-mode checkout after adding items.
Observe the address bar and the green success notice after returning from Stripe.
findings.observedBehavior: URL stayed http://127.0.0.1:5173/ without ?checkout=success&session_id=…, no “Payment confirmed” style notice, cart empty on that origin.
findings.expectedBehavior: The shopper should land on the same host they used, with success or warning copy driven by GET /api/checkout/session-status only after a session_id is present, so payment_status === "paid" is confirmed before showing success.
domHints: Query params checkout and session_id on return URL

findings.description: Many remote product image requests fail in the browser console with net::ERR_CONNECTION_CLOSED during normal shopping.
reproSteps: Load the home page and scroll the product grid.
findings.observedBehavior: Large number of Failed to load resource: net::ERR_CONNECTION_CLOSED errors for unsplash (or similar) image URLs.
findings.expectedBehavior: Product thumbnails should load reliably or fall back gracefully without spamming console errors.
domHints: Product grid images in main catalog
